news.headline: UK police arrest 5 men, counter-terror squad probes ‘major incident’ near air base used by US forces
news.summary: British police said they had evacuated homes Sunday near the air base of Fairford in southwest England used by US air forces and arrested five men over suspected explosives offences. British counter-terrorism police are investigating the incident.
